blocks.orig: Africa Safari Maasai Boma is a special place in a special location; with the Kenyan Masai Mara to the north, Lake Natron to the east, Serengeti National Park to the West, and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area down south. This boma (Maasai village) offers Maasai-style huts (called manyattas) for 2 to 3 people, and 2 family manyattas for a maximum of 6 guests. They are well-appointed with lovely wooden furniture, an ensuite bathroom with a European toilet, ceiling fans and a private balcony. The lodge also features a restaurant, bar and a swimming pool. And of course, at night the campfire is lit to allow you to share your stories by the fire – like a true Maasai.
blocks.html: Africa Safari Maasai Boma is a special place in a special spot, with the Kenyan Masai Mara to the north, Lake Natron to the east, Serengeti National Park to the west and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area to the south. In this boma (Maasai village) you stay in Maasai-style huts (known as manyattas) for 2 to 3 people, or in one of the 2 family manyattas for up to 6 guests. They are nicely furnished with lovely wooden furniture and have an ensuite bathroom with a European toilet, ceiling fans and a private balcony. There is also a restaurant, a bar and a swimming pool. And naturally, the campfire is lit in the evening so you can swap stories around the fire – just like a real Maasai.
